Yes, this feels helpful without getting in my way. When I typed the half-finished `rome AND (`, the app didn't panic or wipe my list — all my bookmarks stayed put, my half-typed query stayed in the box so I could keep going, and it just quietly told me the search wasn't finished yet. That's the right touch: it's clearly waiting for me to finish rather than treating my mid-typing as an error to punish. Then the moment I completed it to `rome AND #article`, the real results popped right in.

Honestly, I'm glad the message is in plain language — "that search isn't complete yet" — rather than getting technical at me. As long as it holds steady and doesn't throw away my collection or my typing while I'm still building the search, I'm happy, and it does exactly that.

So this incomplete-search recovery is good.
